source.title: Pin Cushion
source.description:
Whoa! Awfully brave to be stomping around the shooting grounds amidst our training. You're practically begging for a projectile to the knee, or maybe your behind given the way you're shuffling around.

But hey, your safety is your prerogative. Since you seem like a real risk taker, why not lend us a helping hand? Gathering our arrows after every round of shots takes away from precious shooting time.

How about you go grab a few for me, eh?
source.objective: Fetch arrows in the archery range south of the New Avalon town square. You may also acquire arrows when fighting rangers.
source.progress: Those arrows won't fetch themselves. What are you waiting for?
source.completion:
Still alive, I see! Watching you dart around the range brought me a few laughs. I will admit, I expected you to scurry away when they started shooting right at you.

Thanks for giving my archers a moving target to practice with. I didn't think you would be stupid enough to try it, so I didn't have a reward in mind.

Hmm. How about I teach you how to craft a quiver? It'll make your job easier next time.
